measures.name: Failure Events
measures.expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS('Failures'), 0)
measures.description: Component failure records in selected period. Simultaneous component failures count separately.

measures.name: Machines With Failures
measures.expression: COALESCE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Failures'[Machine ID]), 0)
measures.description: Distinct machines with at least one failure record in selected period; not failure event count.

measures.name: Error Events
measures.expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS('Errors'), 0)
measures.description: Non-breaking error records in selected period.

measures.name: Replacement Records
measures.expression: COALESCE(COUNTROWS('Maintenance'), 0)
measures.description: Component replacement records including replacements related to failure. Do not add this to failures as unique incidents.

measures.name: Observed Telemetry Hours
measures.expression: SUM('Daily Health'[Reading Count])
measures.description: One timestamped hourly sample is one observed telemetry hour; not proof of productive uptime.

measures.name: Observed Machines
measures.expression: DISTINCTCOUNT('Daily Health'[Machine ID])
measures.description: Distinct machines with telemetry in selected period.

measures.name: Failures per 1000 Observed Hours
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Failure Events] * 1000, [Observed Telemetry Hours])
measures.description: Numerator: component failure records in date/machine selection. Denominator: hourly telemetry samples in same selection. Multiplied by 1000. Component filters apply to numerator only.

measures.name: Component Cumulative Share
measures.expression:
VAR _n = [Failure Events]
VAR _components = ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED('Components'[Component]), "Events", [Failure Events])
RETURN DIVIDE(SUMX(FILTER(_components, [Events] >= _n), [Events]), CALCULATE([Failure Events], ALLSELECTED('Components'[Component])))
measures.description: Pareto cumulative fraction by descending component failure count; ties share a position.

measures.name: Plant Insight
measures.expression:
VAR _n = [Failure Events]
VAR _top = TOPN(1, ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED('Components'[Component]), "Events", [Failure Events]), [Events], DESC, 'Components'[Component], ASC)
RETURN FORMAT(_n,"#,##0") & " component failure events; " & FORMAT([Machines With Failures],"0") & " machines with records. " & IF(_n=0,"No failures in selected scope.",CONCATENATEX(_top,'Components'[Component] & " leads (" & FORMAT([Events],"0") & " events)."))
measures.description: Dynamic count and leading component for current report filters.

measures.name: Mean Completed Failure Gap Hours
measures.expression:
VAR _start = MIN('Dates'[Date])
RETURN CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Failure Intervals'[Gap Hours]), KEEPFILTERS('Failure Intervals'[Previous Failure] >= _start))
measures.description: Mean observed gap between distinct machine failure timestamps, both inside selected continuous period. Not MTBF: censored first/last intervals and operating exposure unavailable.

measures.name: Completed Gap Sample
measures.expression:
VAR _start = MIN('Dates'[Date])
RETURN CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Failure Intervals'), KEEPFILTERS('Failure Intervals'[Previous Failure] >= _start))
measures.description: Number of completed gaps contributing to mean; simultaneous components at one timestamp collapse only for this calculation.

measures.name: Sensor Daily Mean
measures.expression: AVERAGE('Sensor Daily'[Mean Reading])
measures.description: Daily sensor average; use one sensor at a time. Reference excludes current day and requires 7 previous daily means.

measures.name: Prior 30 Day Mean
measures.expression: AVERAGE('Sensor Daily'[Prior Mean])
measures.description: Daily sensor average; use one sensor at a time. Reference excludes current day and requires 7 previous daily means.

measures.name: Sensor Deviation Z
measures.expression: AVERAGE('Sensor Daily'[Deviation Z])
measures.description: Daily sensor average; use one sensor at a time. Reference excludes current day and requires 7 previous daily means.

measures.name: Failure Window Mean
measures.expression: CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Failure Windows'[Mean Reading]), 'Failure Windows'[Complete Bin] = 1)
measures.description: Mean of full 24-hour event-relative bins; equal component-event weighting. Descriptive association, not causal.

measures.name: Window Event Sample
measures.expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Failure Windows'[Event ID]), 'Failure Windows'[Complete Bin] = 1)
measures.description: Distinct component failure records contributing to full 24-hour bins in selected relative day and sensor.

measures.name: Window Hour Sample
measures.expression: CALCULATE(SUM('Failure Windows'[Sample Hours]), 'Failure Windows'[Complete Bin] = 1)
measures.description: Sum of event-relative sample hours; overlapping windows reuse telemetry and are not independent observations.

measures.name: As Of Date
measures.expression:
VAR _selected = MAX('Dates'[Date])
VAR _last = CALCULATE(MAX('Daily Health'[Date]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dates'), 'Daily Health'[Date] <= _selected)
RETURN _last
measures.description: Latest available daily snapshot no later than maximum selected date; historical end-of-day convention.

measures.name: Priority Score
measures.expression:
VAR _asOf = [As Of Date]
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_asOf), CALCULATE(MAX('Daily Health'[Recorded Priority Score]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dates'), 'Daily Health'[Date] = _asOf))
measures.description: Latest selected as-of snapshot. For scores and reasons select an individual machine or use the ranking table.

measures.name: Recent Failures 14 Days
measures.expression:

RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_asOf), CALCULATE(MAX('Daily Health'[Failures 14 Days]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dates'), 'Daily Health'[Date] = _asOf))

measures.name: Priority Reasons
measures.expression:
VAR _asOf = [As Of Date]
RETURN IF(HASONEVALUE('Machines'[Machine ID]), CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE('Daily Health'[Recorded Priority Reasons]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dates'), 'Daily Health'[Date] = _asOf), "Select one machine")
measures.description: Rule-based prioritization, not probability; analytical recommendations requiring engineering review.

measures.name: Suggested Inspection
measures.expression:
VAR _asOf = [As Of Date]
RETURN IF(HASONEVALUE('Machines'[Machine ID]), CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE('Daily Health'[Recorded Suggested Inspection]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dates'), 'Daily Health'[Date] = _asOf), "Select one machine")
measures.description: Rule-based prioritization, not probability; analytical recommendations requiring engineering review.

measures.name: Priority Status
measures.expression:
VAR _asOf = [As Of Date]
RETURN IF(HASONEVALUE('Machines'[Machine ID]), CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE('Daily Health'[Priority Band]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dates'), 'Daily Health'[Date] = _asOf), "Select one machine")
measures.description: Rule-based prioritization, not probability; analytical recommendations requiring engineering review.

measures.name: Priority Rank
measures.expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Machines'[Machine ID]), RANKX(ALLSELECTED('Machines'), [Priority Score], , DESC, Dense))
measures.description: Dense rank within model/machine selection at the selected end date.

measures.name: High Priority Machines
measures.expression: SUMX(VALUES('Machines'[Machine ID]), IF([Priority Score] >= 60, 1, 0))
measures.description: Count of machines at rule-based score >=60 as of selected date.

measures.name: Watch Priority Machines
measures.expression: SUMX(VALUES('Machines'[Machine ID]), IF([Priority Score] >= 30 && [Priority Score] < 60, 1, 0))
measures.description: Count at 30<=score<60 as of selected date.

measures.name: Latest Observed Timestamp
measures.expression:
VAR _asOf = [As Of Date]
RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Daily Health'[Latest Timestamp]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dates'), 'Daily Health'[Date] = _asOf)
measures.description: Latest telemetry actually observed at selected snapshot. No live feed.

measures.name: Machine Context
measures.expression: SELECTEDVALUE('Machines'[Machine], "Select one machine") & " | " & SELECTEDVALUE('Machines'[Model], "multiple models") & " | recorded age " & FORMAT(SELECTEDVALUE('Machines'[Age Years]), "0") & " years"
measures.description: Static recorded machine age; does not automatically age through history.

measures.name: Machine History Note
measures.expression: IF([Failure Events]=0,"No recorded failure in this period. ",FORMAT([Failure Events],"0") & " component failure records. ") & IF([Replacement Records]=0,"No replacement record in this period; earlier history may exist.",FORMAT([Replacement Records],"0") & " component replacements in this period.")
measures.description: Separates absence of records from evidence of perfect health.

measures.name: Top Machine Failure Events
measures.expression:
VAR _rank = RANKX(ALLSELECTED('Machines'), [Failure Events], , DESC, Dense)
RETURN IF(_rank <= 10, [Failure Events])
measures.description: Top 10 dense ranks; ties retained.

measures.name: Priority Date Label
measures.expression: "As of " & FORMAT([As Of Date], "dd MMM yyyy") & " | rule-based score, not ML probability"
measures.description: Historical cutoff and score meaning.

measures.name: Sensor Context
measures.expression: SELECTEDVALUE('Sensors'[Sensor], "Select one sensor") & " | source sample units (physical units unspecified)"
measures.description: Sensor identity and unit limitation.
